“AKO LANG ANG MAKUKULONG DAHIL LUMABAN AKO SA MAGNANAKAW’

Diretsahang haharapin ni Cavite 4th District Rep. Kiko Barzaga ang kasong sedition na inihain laban sa kanya ng Dasmariñas Village Homeowners’ Association, kasabay ng pagbitbit niya ng matapang na mensahe sa publiko.

Sa inilabas niyang pahayag, iginiit ni Barzaga:

“Ako lang ang Congressmen na makukulong, hindi dahil sa pagnanakaw, pero dahil kinalaban ko ang mga magnanakaw… Pero ganito talaga ang sitwasyon ng bansa natin, ang sistemang nagpapayaman sa mayayaman at nagpapahirap sa mahihirap!”

Kasunod nito, inanunsyo rin ng kongresista na siya ay personal na tutungo bukas, 10:00 AM sa Makati City Prosecutor’s Office upang harapin ang reklamo:

“I will be in the Makati City Prosecutor’s Office tomorrow, 10:00 AM, to face my sedition case filed by Dasmariñas Village HOA.”

Ang reklamo ng Dasma HOA ay bunsod ng anti-Marcos protest noong Oktubre 12, matapos hikayatin ni Barzaga ang publiko na dalhin ang kanilang galit “to the front doors of the greedy and corrupt.”

Sa protesta, nagdeploy ng anti-riot police at pansamantalang isinara ang McKinley Road matapos dumagsa ang mga demonstrador malapit sa gate ng Dasmariñas Village.

Habang ipinaglalaban ng HOA ang “kapayapaan at seguridad” ng kanilang komunidad, iginiit naman ni Barzaga na ang tunay na dahilan ng kaso ay ang pagtindig niya laban sa aniya’y nakikinabang sa sistemang nagpapahirap sa publiko.

Sa kabila ng kinakaharap na kaso, malinaw ang mensahe ng kongresista: hindi siya uurong, at haharapin niya ang proseso nang nakataas ang noo.

🧩 THE MISSING PIECE: Why the Madriaga Affidavit Finally Makes the Last 6 Years Make Sense

Have you ever looked at a finished puzzle and realized one specific piece explains the whole picture?

That is what the affidavit of Ramil Lagunoy Madriaga (dated Nov 29, 2025) is. 

It’s not just a list of accusations. It is the legend to the map of scandals we watched unfold from 2018 to 2023.

When you lay his testimony next to the news headlines we saw on TV, the "coincidences" disappear, and a terrifyingly consistent pattern emerges.

Let’s connect the dots like a professor looking at a timeline. 🕵️‍♂️📝

1️⃣ The "Run Sara Run" Machinery (2018-2019)

🧠 What Madriaga Says: In 2018, he was introduced to Mayor Sara Duterte and assigned to "intelligence operations" to prepare for a national run.

📺 What We Saw on the News: Remember when "Run Sara Run" tarps just appeared everywhere? Or those massive "parallel caravans" in 2019? We thought it was grassroots support. The affidavit suggests it was a state-sponsored intelligence operation years in the making.

👉 The Uh-huh Moment: The infrastructure was being built while they were still denying she would run.

2️⃣ The POGO Connection (2020-2021)

🧠 What Madriaga Says: Campaign cash wasn't just donations; it was picked up in bags from hotels and malls (The Gate, Vertis North, Seda) funded by POGO operators and drug dealers.

📺 What We Saw on the News: This is exactly when the Philippines saw a massive surge in illegal POGO hubs in Pampanga and NCR. AMLAC was screaming about "red flags" and foreign cash inflows.

👉 The Uh-huh Moment: The explosion of POGOs wasn't a failure of regulation; it was a feature of campaign financing.
3️⃣ The Honda Civics & The Campaign (Jan 2022)

🧠 What Madriaga Says: He drove Honda Civics filled with cash to the Santiago family home in Novaliches on Sara's orders.

📺 What We Saw on the News: This was the exact height of the 2022 campaign season. Rallies, caravans, and machinery require liquid cash.

👉 The Uh-huh Moment: While we were debating debates, actual trunks full of cash were allegedly moving through Quezon City traffic.

4️⃣ The 11-Day Magic Trick (Dec 2022)

🧠 What Madriaga Says: In late 2022, DepEd vehicles were used to move duffle bags containing ₱33M-₱35M each to a comedy bar and the Ombudsman parking lot.

📺 What We Saw on the News: This is the exact same month the OVP spent ₱125 Million in Confidential Funds in just 11 days.

👉 The Uh-huh Moment: We always asked, "How do you spend that much money in 11 days?" Madriaga’s answer: You don't spend it. You distribute it in duffle bags.

5️⃣ Buying Silence? (2020-2023)

🧠 What Madriaga Says: He delivered an ₱80 Million payload to SM Megamall, picked up by the wife of an Ombudsman Prosecutor (a classmate of Sara).

📺 What We Saw on the News: For years, the Ombudsman refused to release the Duterte SALNs and declined to investigate the confidential funds.

👉 The Uh-huh Moment: The institution meant to check their power was allegedly on the payroll.

6️⃣ The Magnetic Lifters (2018)

🧠 What Madriaga Says: Mans Carpio ordered him to "pick up the magnetic lifters" at the Bureau of Customs.

📺 What We Saw on the News: The billions of pesos worth of shabu found inside magnetic lifters - one of the biggest smuggling scandals in history.

👉 The Uh-huh Moment: It wasn't incompetence at Customs. It was allegedly a direct order from the family in power.

🎓 The Professor’s Conclusion:

Coincidence happens once. Maybe twice. But when an affidavit written in 2025 perfectly overlays the dates, locations, and amounts of six years of national scandals? 

That is not a coincidence. That is a system.

Madriaga didn’t just tell us what they did; he explained how they did what we already witnessed.

The puzzle is complete. The question is, what do we do with the picture now? 🇵🇭
